record.body:
## Interfaces

orchestra and dashboard entry points call adaptive_artifacts.project.open_store and then Project.get, Project.list, Project.create, or Project.apply. orchestra/aa_resolve.py and dashboard/artifact_store.py are deleted. close_batch imports is_assertion_level_red, run_verdict, and recheck inside _assertion_level_red and _run_aff_claim_gate, and a missing import raises OracleAdapterUnavailable or CloseRefused whose message names affidavit. orchestra.cli loads close_batch only for the close-batch command. pyproject.toml dependencies lists adaptive-artifacts. tests/test_orchestra_callers.py covers R1–R7, R9, and R10; R8 is the acceptance command that runs bin/orchestra --help with affidavit blocked.

## Assumptions

The work-item section of the brief was empty, so this grade uses the requirements, design, decisions, and acceptances. Execution reports, check-runs, assessments, and assignments were not used. Affidavit's run_verdict(cwd, at, base, claim_ids), recheck(cwd, claim), and is_assertion_level_red(check_run) match the calls in close_batch. The uv script environments under ~/.cache/uv/environments-v2 named -main-* are the environments produced for these __main__.py scripts.

## Invariants

Help does not import affidavit: the only affidavit imports are function-local in orchestra/close_batch.py, and cli.py imports that module only after the close-batch command is selected. No orchestra or dashboard module reads SE_WORKFLOW_STORE or a store-binding file; those resolvers are gone and entry points call open_store. Store opening in the tree goes through open_store, except scripts/record_reader.py still builds ~/.artifacts/<basename> when a custom runner is injected; the production runner short-circuits to open_store. The shared-environment assumption does not hold for the uv script launchers.

## Conflicts

Skill text still says `orchestra store run -- <args>` runs adaptive-artifacts. orchestra.cli._dispatch_store accepts only list, get, create, and apply. Skills were left as command callers, which matches the phase constraint.
